name: Jetray
abilities: Supersonic flight (several times the speed of sound; hyperspace-capable)
Neuroshock blasts from eyes and tail (shut down nervous systems, blow holes in engine blocks)
Space and underwater survivability (breathes and swims fast underwater)
Immunity to fire/heat, radiation and electricity
Durability (took multiple blows from Vilgax, jet gunfire)
weaknesses: Neuroshock blasts useless against robots and Talpaedans
summary: Ben's fastest flier in Alien Force and Ultimate Alien: a red manta-ray alien that breaks the sound barrier and fires neuroshock beams from its eyes and tail.
traits: Shoots from both eyes AND tail
Slower than XLR8 on the ground
notableFeats: Discovered the Highbreed crop circles while dogfighting Alan (Everybody Talks About the Weather)
Flew Reinrassig III from Augstaka to Earth via hyperspace (If All Else Fails)
Battled Air Force jets and saved a pilot (Fame)
Destroyed the Hand of Armageddon, defeating Eon (Ben 10,000 Returns)
Evolved the pterodactyls back into chickens with the evolution ray (The Eggman Cometh)

appearances.designNotes: Red manta-ray humanoid, yellow horns and patagia, green eyes, gills under arms, black lightning-bolt stripes running to the recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest.

image.label: UAF
image.notes: only infobox image (unlabelled); Jetray had a single design shared by AF and UA - visually verified: red manta body, Omnitrix on chest

appearances.designNotes: Identical to Alien Force with the Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Heroes United (non-diegetic cameo) drew the stripes straight instead of lightning-bolted.

scoring.rationale: Supersonic, hyperspace-capable flight (9) that works in air, water and space, with neuroshock beams that dropped a Pyronite and an Amperi and destroyed the Hand of Armageddon. Broad immunities (fire, radiation, electricity). Beams do nothing to robots and he is a mid-tier brawler at best.

notes: IMPORTANT: Jetray was NOT used on-screen in Omniverse - only photos in Jimmy's room (Return to Forever) and mentions; the wiki trivia states he is the only regular AF/UA alien not used in OV. No OV appearance created despite the brief's assumption. 'OV Jetray Full Design.png' / 'OV Flashbacks Jetray.png' in the gallery are 2020 GoFundMe drawings by Derrick J. Wyatt, not on-screen.
Also used by Albedo (Good Copy, Bad Copy) and Kevin (Inspector 13).
Ultimate Ben used Jetray's powers in Ben 10,000 Returns (not a transformation).
AF S1 (wiki) = ben-15-af, AF S2 = ben-16-af.
